name: Rileck Maverick (CR 1/2)
body:
RILECK MAVERICK
CR 1/2

This tall, thin humanoid has light green skin. Although hairless, she has two long tendrils that trail from the back of her head like tentacles or tails.

XP 200
Rileck swashbuckler 1
CN Medium humanoid (psionic, rileck)
Init +2; Senses Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +2 armor, +1 shield)
hp 13 (1d10+2+1)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +0; +4 vs. disease and poison
Defensive Abilities body control

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee rapier +4 (1d6 P, 18-20/×2)
Ranged shortbow +3 (1d6/x3 P, range incr. 60 ft.)
Special Attacks swashbuckler finesse

Psi-Like Abilities (ML 1st; concentration +4)

1/day—empathic connection

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 10, Cha 16
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Weapon Focus (rapier), Wild Talent
Skills Acrobatics +6, Bluff +9, Perception +4; Species Modifiers +2 Bluff
Languages Common, Rileck
SQ energy surge (1/day), deeds (derring-do, dodging panache, opportune parry and riposte), panache (max. 3 points), psionics (2 pp)
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, buckler, rapier, shortbow with 20 arrows, other gear)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Body Control (Ex)

Rilecks can survive comfortably in conditions between 0 and 120 degrees Fahrenheit without having to attempt Fortitude saves to resist nonlethal damage. In conditions of more severe cold or heat, they need attempt Fortitude saves only once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes. A rileck can hold their breath for 4 rounds per point of Constitution before beginning to need to make saves to avoid suffocation. Finally, they can go twice as long without food or water as most species.

Energy Surge (Ex)

Once per day, you can take an extra move action. This doesn’t stack with other abilities that would allow you to take an extra action in a round.

ABOUT

When their homeworld was invaded, rilecks scattered across the Galaxy. Many accepted positions of servitude in order to survive. However, some become adventurers who embrace a life of danger and romance.
